<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1445
Claimant:
Steven Chavez
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
06/09/2025
Claim received for a sideswipe that occurred whlie the insured's vehicle was changing lanes. The claimant is
represented by counsel, and all further contact will be routed through the attorney's office.
06/27/2025
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Statements from the
other driver and two independent witnesses describe the collision the same way the claimant did.
06/28/2025
Photographs of the scene and both vehicles were uploaded to the file. The damage pattern is largely consistent with
the impact described, with most of it concentrated along the passenger-side panels.
07/11/2025
Confirmed with the policy records that the driver involved is listed as a named driver on the policy. Coverage was in
force at the time of loss, and nothing in the vehicle history points to damage that predates the policy start.
07/19/2025
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who reported whiplash symptoms. The claimant has given the same account of
events in every conversation so far, without material variation.
08/09/2025
Medical records show the claimant was treated for the same body area within the past two years. The earlier
condition appears to add to the current complaints, and the treating provider has been asked to separate the two in
the notes.
08/24/2025
The reported injury is consistent with the type and force of the collision. Treatment has followed a typical course, with
visits tapering as the claimant's symptoms improved.
12/11/2025
No prior damage to the insured vehicle is known from inspection or from any previous claim on file. The repair
estimate has been reviewed against the photos and the described impact.
01/15/2026
File is being prepared for the next review step. Remaining items include the final treatment summary from the
provider and the attorney's demand letter, once received.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
